name: idea-to-spec
title: Idea → Structured Feature Spec
description: Transform a raw idea into a structured feature specification with research, cross-module analysis, and validation. Outputs a draft spec ready for backlog grooming.
author: SolFoundy

inputs.name: idea
inputs.description: Raw idea or proposal (problem statement, vision, or feature concept)

inputs.name: target_version
inputs.description: Target release version (e.g., 'v0.1.0', 'v0.2.0') — constrains scope to features deliverable without non-existent external dependencies

agents.prompt:
Validate the drafted specification for completeness and quality.

Drafted spec:
{{spec-drafter}}

Out-of-scope features: {{scope-guardian.out_of_scope}}

Validation checklist:
1. Spec ID follows the suggested format? ✓/✗
2. Title is clear and specific (not vague)? ✓/✗
3. DONE-WHEN criteria are measurable and testable? ✓/✗
4. CONTEXT explains the user value or business case? ✓/✗
5. ARCHITECTURE describes key design decisions? ✓/✗
6. DEPENDENCIES identifies all blockers? ✓/✗
7. OPEN QUESTIONS lists unresolved decisions? ✓/✗
8. Integration points are addressed? ✓/✗
9. Complexity estimate is justified? ✓/✗
10. No scope creep (spec stays focused on the original idea)? ✓/✗
11. No scope creep — only in-scope features from scope-guardian included? ✓/✗
12. All DONE-WHEN criteria deliverable without non-existent external dependencies? ✓/✗

Your task:
1. For each failing check, suggest a specific correction
2. Score spec quality (1-10) — completeness, clarity, testability
3. Flag any risks (scope creep, missing dependencies, unclear ownership)
4. Recommend ACCEPT (score >= 7) or ITERATE (score < 7)
5. If ITERATE, list the required revisions

Return JSON: { "checks": {}, "quality_score": 0, "risks": [], "recommendation": "ACCEPT|ITERATE", "revisions": [] }
